GUIDE.title: DH Unidentified — Module Guide
GUIDE.requirementBody: To request an identify roll, the player must have a character assigned to their user account. The Request Identify Roll dialog only lists users who are connected, are not GMs, and have such a character — without one there is no inventory to read.
GUIDE.assignLabel: How to assign a character to a user:
GUIDE.assignStep1: Right-click the user name in the Players list and open User Configuration.
GUIDE.assignStep2: Pick the actor for that user. The user must have ownership of that actor.
GUIDE.hidingBody: Works on weapons, armor, loot and consumables. Right-click the item in an actor's inventory and choose Mystify Item, or open the item sheet and use the ⋮ header menu. A dialog lets you set the masked name, description and icon that players will see.
GUIDE.hidingNote: Nothing is written over the item itself. The real name, image and description stay in the document at all times — the mask is presentation only, applied when the sheet renders. Disable the module and every item is immediately back to normal.
GUIDE.revealingBody: To reveal an item straight away, right-click it and choose Identify Item, or use the ⋮ menu on its sheet and confirm with Identify. To make the players earn it, send them a roll instead — see below.
GUIDE.rollBody: Open Identify Items from the Daggerheart Menu, or run Identify.Open() in a macro.
GUIDE.rollStep1: Pick the player on the left. Their unidentified items are listed below.
GUIDE.rollStep2: Click an item to select it. The magnifier opens its real sheet if you need a look.
GUIDE.rollStep3: Pick a trait and a difficulty, and toggle Advantage or Disadvantage if the situation calls for it.
GUIDE.rollStep4: Click Send to Player. A prompt appears on their screen.
GUIDE.rollNote: The player only ever sees the masked name and icon in that prompt. On a success the item reveals itself; on a failure it stays hidden and you can try again later.
GUIDE.partyBody: Unidentified items sitting on a party actor are offered too, marked with a purple edge and a group icon. Any player can be asked to identify one — the item never has to be on their own character. The party actor qualifies when every player owns it, either through default ownership set to Owner or an explicit Owner grant for each player.
GUIDE.privacyBody: In module settings, Identify Result Privacy controls who learns the outcome. Public (the default) shows the result to the whole table. Private keeps the roll, the result message and the sound between the player who rolled and the GM. This setting is GM-only and applies to every request.
GUIDE.defaultsBody: Configure Default Masks in module settings sets the masked name, description and icon suggested for each item type, so mystifying is usually one click and done. Leave a name or description empty to use the built-in text in your current language. The same dialog sets the success and failure sounds played when a roll resolves.
